title: The boss lab opens in the bait mode with twenty Reeds, and the Reeds and the boss come up out of the game's own sinkhole
context: Owner, 2026-10-10: "make the default 20 reeds, and make the default mode when landing on #boss the Bait-Isao mode. ... 3) the initial Tremor is not just the ground shaking, it is our sinkhole animation from the game mode." Follows 2026-10-10-boss-bait-wave-emergence-120hz-carcasses, whose tremor was the seat's camera shaken, dust puffs and the breach's quake low-passed. The game's src/game-breaches.js, src/sinkhole.js and src/fx/sinkhole are reused unchanged; src/labs/boss/game-seat.js and the bait-mode files were another agent's in this session and are untouched.
outcome: DEFAULTS: labs.html#boss opens in the bait mode (the MODE select on bait), ?mode=tank opens the tank mode; BOSS_FIGHT.wave.count is 20 (the slider and ?reeds=N still override, 0 the boss at once). The browser steps that tested the tank mode or switched into the bait mode from it (--boss, --boss-fight, --boss-walls, --boss-cam, --boss-under, --boss-bait, --boss-wave) open with &mode=tank; the publish script's front page sets reeds=20 (boss.html needs no change: it sets mode=bait and no count). THE SINKHOLE (src/labs/boss/sinkhole.js): the lab hosts the game's own adapter, src/game-breaches.js, the one td-tab.js opens every breach through, so the sinkhole is src/sinkhole.js on the src/fx/sinkhole kit with nothing forked. The adapter works on the unit sphere (a breach at a normal, one cell its scale, the planet 1/scale cells round) and cuts the hole out of the ground in world space; the lab's breaches live in a group in the sphere group scaled by the planet's radius, so inside it the world is the game's, and the adapter re-reads each sinkhole's frame every update, which follows the seat's scaling of the scene to game units. The lab planet's floors and grid lines are patched with the adapter's patch(), as td-tab.js patches its floor and edge meshes, so the ground opens; its programs and stone maps are warmed at build through the adapter's warm() and src/fx/shader-warm.js, as the game does at boot. Nothing in the sinkhole is tied to the grid (the hole is a disc in the breach's frame), so it opens on the arena's centre itself: no cell lookup was needed. THE SEQUENCE: a round of the bait mode opens one at the centre (wave.sinkhole.reeds = 1 cell, the game's size, a 10 m hole); the adapter triggers it once the stone maps are in, the quake sounds then (td-tab.js's onOpen sound, at the camera's distance in game units), 1.6 s of rumble, the plates break and the hole opens; the Reeds' turns (0.6 s apart) count from the frame it is ready by the game's own spawn rule, gameBreaches.ready (the opening run to its 6.98 s duration, what src/fx/enemy-step.js waits on before a body leaves a breach); each rises out of it as before (the drawing lifted, the body settled on its floor). Every Reed up, the hole is sealed with the game's rubble cap (the adapter's seal), so the Reeds do not walk over a void. The last Reed dead, another opens at the centre for the boss (wave.sinkhole.boss = 2 cells: the boss is 40 m across), the rubble hidden once its ground breaks, and the boss rises once that one is ready. The seat is no longer shaken (the game's sinkhole shakes no camera: td-tab.js never reads its rig); the dust puffs and the low-passed rumble are gone. Isao's keep-out is unchanged (25 m while a Reed is still to come up, now including the wait for the hole; 45 m while the boss's hole opens and it rises). MEASURED (headless, the seat): the first Reed left 'below' at the sinkhole's age 7.0 s, none before it was ready; 20 Reeds all up 4.0 m from the centre, Isao never nearer than 25.0 m; the sinkhole's phases rumbling > open > sealed, one quake; the boss's rise starts once its hole is ready (no lift before); 20 Reeds at 120 Hz 46.4 fps, clock x0.23 (as before).
alternatives: Copying the sinkhole into the lab (rejected: the brief and the constraints reuse the game's fx; the adapter takes a scene, a camera and the lab's audio as they are)

Driving src/sinkhole.js directly, as the laser lab does (rejected: the adapter is the game's breach, with its trigger on the stone maps, its quake, its ready rule, the ground's cut and its seal; the laser lab hand-places one sinkhole for a still scene)

Snapping the breach to the lab planet's nearest cell centre (not needed: the game opens on cells because its spawn points are cells; the sinkhole is a disc in its own frame, and a snap would move it up to ~5 m off where the Reeds come up)

The Reeds' turns from the hole reaching its radius (~2 s after the trigger) instead of the game's ready (6.98 s) (rejected: the game's spawn queue waits for ready; the owner asked for the game's animation, and the opening's plates and stones are still flying before it)
Leaving the Reeds' hole open (rejected: the Reeds walk a flat floor and would cross the void; sealed with the game's rubble once every one is up)
One cell for the boss as well (rejected: a 20 m hole under a 40 m body; two cells, the knob wave.sinkhole.boss)
Keeping the seat's shake with the sinkhole (rejected: the game's breach shakes no camera; the seat's shake() in game-seat.js is now unused, left for its owner to remove)
evidence: node --check on every edited file; from a snapshot of HEAD plus this change only (another agent's uncommitted boss-bait work left out): npm test (test/boss-sinkhole.mjs new: the host scaled by the radius, a breach on the unit sphere under a local point, one cell and two, one at a time with the earlier sealed, ready by the adapter's duration, the quake once at the camera's game-unit distance, floors and grid lines patched, reset; test/boss-wave.mjs: count 20, the sinkhole knob), npm run check, npm run build green

from that snapshot, sequentially, one headless Chrome (memory WARN on pinned swap, 30 % headroom): --boss-wave green: ?mode=tank opens the tank; the floors' and edges' program key game-breach-ground-v1; the sinkhole module src/game-breaches.js opened for the Reeds at the centre, 1 cell, tronColors, planet; rumbling > open > sealed; the first Reed out at age 7.01 s, ready, none early; 20 Reeds below > tremor > rising > up, each 4.0 m from the centre, the seat's shake count 0, Isao at 25.0 m nearest; 120 Hz at twenty; the boss's own sinkhole (2 cells) at the centre, no lift before it was ready, Isao 45 m; R: a fresh sinkhole, no rubble; the carcass decay check now shortens the decay to leave the oldest 6 s (the boss's wait leaves them older than 6 s)

then --boss-friends green (the friends' link in the bait mode as before), --boss green (?mode=tank), --boss-fight green on its second run (the first lost the circling tank to a Bofors round at 15 s of fight clock before an MK-9 was scheduled, so the 'all four shooters' check saw three: a chance loss of the tank mode's own schedule, no sinkhole there), --boss-cam green
